title: Two artifact paths differing only in case
why: `mask.png` beside `MASK.PNG` is two committed files on Linux and one file on Windows and on a default macOS filesystem, so the record either hashes the wrong bytes or cannot be checked out intact. The identical failure the case-folded **id** check prevents, one level down — the portable-identity rule has to apply wherever a name becomes a path, not only to the directory.
